body.label: Effect
body.html: Manifest an Ancestor's practiced strike against one creature within 2 units. On a success, deal 1 Radiant damage.

surges.html: If the associated bond is not Broken, gain +1 die on your next Calling Action using the same subtype.

rider.title: ANCESTOR — FULL MANIFESTATION
rider.html: If you spent at least 5 dice on this Action, as it resolves you may spend 3 additional Mana to fully manifest your Ancestor.
